grants.name: WIOA via AJCC / CalJOBS
grants.eligibility: Job seeker needing career planning or training. Local AJCC determines eligibility.
grants.coverage: Career advice, job search help, and local AJCC training services at no cost. Tuition, books, tests, and tools may be funded.
grants.action: Create a CalJOBS account, then visit your local AJCC for WIOA screening.

grants.name: Per Scholas Los Angeles
grants.eligibility: Los Angeles County resident. All experience levels accepted.
grants.coverage: No-cost training. CompTIA A+ and Google IT Support Professional Certificate included.
grants.action: Apply via the Per Scholas Los Angeles course page.

grants.name: Futuro Health — Registered Dental Assistant
grants.eligibility: CA resident, US work authorization, high school diploma or GED, PC and internet access, availability of 20+ hours/week.
grants.coverage: Tuition-free program leading to State Board Examination for Registered Dental Assistant.
grants.action: Create an account at the Futuro Health catalog and check regional availability.

grants.name: Dental Assistant Apprenticeship — CA Apprenticeship / Local COE
grants.eligibility: Varies by program (e.g., Butte County CTE, Santa Cruz COE).
grants.coverage: No-cost program with paid on-the-job training. Prepares for State Board / RDA credential.
grants.action: Search CA DIR apprenticeship listings for 'Dental Assistant'.

grants.name: County Workforce Programs
grants.eligibility: Unemployed or underemployed residents. Geographic rules vary by county.
grants.coverage: Training at no cost. Programs include auto mechanic, electrician, and micro-computer repair.
grants.action: Contact your nearest AJCC for Adult or Dislocated Worker screening.

grants.name: Maintenance Mechanic / Industrial Mechanic Apprenticeships
grants.eligibility: Registered apprenticeship rules apply (e.g., Chaffey College InTech Center). Employer sponsorship may be required.
grants.coverage: Paid on-the-job training combined with classroom instruction.
grants.action: Review the Chaffey College InTech page for Industrial Mechanic openings.

grants.name: Hospital / Health Center Paid Training
grants.eligibility: Cohort-based enrollment (up to 30 seats for CCALAC programs).
grants.coverage: CCALAC: 110-hour paid internship with $1,500 stipend. Propel America: tuition-free Medical Assistant training.
grants.action: Apply to CCALAC or Propel America based on current cohort availability.

grants.name: California Cybersecurity Workforce Grants (RAMPS)
grants.eligibility: Institutional funding (partnerships and schools). Not a direct-to-student grant.
grants.coverage: Funds local cybersecurity workforce pipelines through partner institutions.
grants.action: Ask your local AJCC if they are connected to any RAMPS-funded partners.
